description: This file implements the IpcLoop class, which manages an inter-process communication (IPC) event loop, including thread management, channel creation, and RPC controller setup within the rialto server manager project.

classes.name: IpcLoop
classes.description: A class that manages an IPC event loop, including thread lifecycle, channel communication, and RPC controller creation within the rialto server manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of IpcLoop, establishing IPC channel and starting the event thread.

methods.name: IpcLoop
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC channel, controller factory, client reference, and starting the IPC thread.

methods.name: ~IpcLoop
methods.description: Destructor that signals thread termination, disconnects the IPC channel, joins the thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ipcThread
methods.description: Main loop running in a separate thread to process IPC events and handle disconnection.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Returns the current IPC channel object.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure object, choosing between polling or semaphore-based depending on thread context.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller for sending RPC requests.
